description:
Update single Notes Log.

#### See - [Daily Log guide](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/daily-logs) - for additional info on
* Attachments
* Locations

parameters.name: run_configurable_validations
parameters.description: If true, validations are run for the corresponding Configurable Field Set.

rejection_reason.description: Reason given when the log was rejected. Null when no reason was given or the log is not rejected.

rejected_by.description: User who rejected the log. Null when the log is not rejected.

id.description: ID of the user who rejected the log.

name.description: Name of the user who rejected the log.

company.description: The rejecting user's company (vendor) in the project company's directory. Null when the user has no vendor.

rejected_at.description: Timestamp when the log was rejected. Null when the log is not rejected.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Notes Log.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Notes Log was created.

daily_log_header_id.description: ID of the parent Daily Log Header.

is_issue_day.description: Whether the note flags an issue affecting the project.

position.description: Order in which this entry was recorded

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Notes Log was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the Notes Log was deleted; null if not deleted.

created_by_collaborator.description: Whether this log was created by a collaborator.

data_type.description: Data type of the Custom Field Definition

value.description: The value of the custom field

variant.description: The variant of the Custom Field Definition (e.g. `phone_number`). Present only when the definition has an associated variant.

data_type.description: Data type of the Custom Field Definition

value.description: The value of the custom field

data_type.description: Data type of the Custom Field Definition

value.description: The value of the custom field

data_type.description: Data type of the Custom Field Definition

variant.description: The variant of the Custom Field Definition (e.g. `project_directory`). Present only when the definition has an associated variant.

data_type.description: Data type of the Custom Field Definition

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to Location

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the segment was soft deleted

deleted.description: Indicates if the segment is deleted

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this vendor/company.

name.description: Display name of the vendor or contractor company.

400.description: Can not update due to errors

403.description: User does not have right permissions

409.description: Conflict. A rejection reason was sent for a log that is already rejected, and either the log already has a reason or a non-null reason was sent.

date.description: Date of record. Format: YYYY-MM-DD Example: 2016-04-19

datetime.description: Datetime of record. Mutually exclusive with the date property.

is_issue_day.description: The note being added is an issue affecting the project

location_id.description: The ID of the Location of the Notes Log. `location_id` takes precedence over `mt_location`

mt_location.description: Use this for creating a new multi-tier or single-tier Location. This will be ignored if `location_id` is provided.

items.description: Look at Daily Log Guide for more info.

vendor_id.description: ID of the Vendor associated to the notes log

custom_field_%{custom_field_definition_i.description:
Value of the custom field. The data type of the value passed in corresponds with the data_type of the Custom Field Definition.
For a lov_entry data_type the value passed in should be the ID of one ...

attachments.description:
Notes Log Attachments.
To upload attachments you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `attachments[]` as files.

items.description: Look at Daily Log Guide for more info.
